name: Morse.Homology.TopTriple.δ
why: The literal equalities in the blind T hold by rfl: the project's relHomology objects are definitionally the blind H_n(C(X)/C(A)), and pairXY.snd = pairYZ.fst = Y. So T is not the junk 0 but deltaTB, the pair boundary of (X, Y) followed by H_n(Y) → H_n(Y, Z). The project's own TopTriple.δ_eq gives exactly this factorisation of δ (the connecting map of 0 → C(Y,Z) → C(X,Z) → C(X,Y) → 0), and the relevant ShortExact.δ maps and homologyMaps agree by rfl. Equal outright, with no sign difference.
